### The Sin of Sodom
Author: Tyler Kenney
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-sin-of-sodom
Passage: Ezekiel 16:49-50
Points:
- Ezekiel reveals that Sodom's root offense was inner arrogance accompanied by luxury and neglect of the poor.
- Focusing purely on external moral standards can easily conceal spiritual pride.
- Believers must oppose arrogance in their own hearts and churches as fiercely as external immorality.
- A humble posture is necessary to speak lovingly and wisely to others about God's truth.
